#step.index.html: Run one generation. The red finch flies to each creature the predator takes, and a black skull stamps down on each one lost to chance; then the survivors breed. Takes about 6 to 7 seconds, or about 1.5 with reduced motion.
#step.mono.html: Run one generation. The red finch flies to each creature the predator takes, and a black skull stamps down on each one lost to chance; then the survivors breed. Takes about 6 to 7 seconds, or about 1.5 with reduced motion.
#step.spots.html: Run one generation. The red finch flies to each creature the predator takes, and a black skull stamps down on each one lost to chance; then the survivors breed. Takes about 6 to 7 seconds, or about 1.5 with reduced motion.
#step.squirts.html: Run one generation. The red perch swims to each creature the predator takes, and a black skull stamps down on each one lost to chance; then the survivors breed. Takes about 6 to 7 seconds, or about 1.5 with reduced motion.

#n: How many generations "Run N generations" will run. Ten by default.
#multi: Run the number of generations in the box at once, with no marks, and show only the result.
#reset: Start over with a new random background, a new random population, and generation 0.
#mut: When checked, each child has a 30% chance of a small change to its genes. Uncheck to allow only recombination.

#bglabel.index.html: The background color as #RRGGBB. Each creature's color is measured against it.
#bglabel.mono.html: The background gene as a 32-bit number in hex, drawn as gray. Creatures are judged against it.
#bglabel.spots.html: The background gene as a 32-bit number in hex, drawn as gray. Use the slider to change it.
#bglabel.squirts.html: The background color as #RRGGBB. Use the Hue and Value sliders to change it.

#grid > div.org.index.html: A butterfly and how closely it matches the background, from 0 to 100%. The least hidden are eaten; a child takes the hue of one parent and the saturation and value of the other.
#grid > div.org.mono.html: A gray moth and how closely its shade matches the background, from 0 to 100%. A child takes the high half of one parent's gene and the low half of the other's.
#grid > div.org.spots.html: A spotted moth and how closely its average gray, over wings and body, matches the background, from 0 to 100%. A child takes spot shade from one parent and pattern from the other.
#grid > div.org.squirts.html: A squid and how closely its color matches the background, from 0 to 100%. The least hidden are eaten; a child takes the hue of one parent and the saturation and value of the other.

#stats: The generation count and the population's average distance from the background. Lower means better camouflage.
a[href='index.html']: Go to the Color version: butterflies in full color.
a[href='mono.html']: Go to the Monochrome version: gray moths with 32-bit genes.
a[href='spots.html']: Go to the Spots version: white moths with gray spots.
a[href='squirts.html']: Go to the Squirts version: squid in full color.

#bgs.spots.html: Set the background gray from 0 (black) to 255 (white). It changes right away, without a reset.

#rbg.spots.html: Pick a new random gray background without resetting the population.

#hue.squirts.html: Set the background hue around the color wheel, 0 to 360. It changes right away, without a reset.

#val.squirts.html: Move the background from white (0) through full hue (50) to black (100). It changes right away.

#sound.index.html: Turn sound on or off. When on, Next generation plays bird chirps as the finch hunts and a thump as each skull stamp lands. It is off until you click it, and Run N generations and reduced motion stay silent.
#sound.mono.html: Turn sound on or off. When on, Next generation plays bird chirps as the finch hunts and a thump as each skull stamp lands. It is off until you click it, and Run N generations and reduced motion stay silent.
#sound.spots.html: Turn sound on or off. When on, Next generation plays bird chirps as the finch hunts and a thump as each skull stamp lands. It is off until you click it, and Run N generations and reduced motion stay silent.
#sound.squirts.html: Turn sound on or off. When on, Next generation plays perch sounds as the fish hunts and a thump as each skull stamp lands. It is off until you click it, and Run N generations and reduced motion stay silent.
